newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline holds slightly higher in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline holds slightly higher in quiet market.

text.p: NWE gasoline held on to earlier gains, seen on the back of slightly firmer crude, but the long U.S. long weekend and a week-long industry function in London next week dampened trade.

Eurograde barges were steady at $204/$206 fob ARA. A deal at $206 fob Rotterdam was heard done in early trade, while a number of p+c deals were reported in the $204/$206 range. Regular unleaded was steady at $198/$200.
The cargo market was fairly quiet. The arbitrage to the U.S. remained closed except for very large cargoes and there was talk of possible South American demand but this was not confirmed.
"If you can find someone who wants the material and will pay the price you're just on the cusp of making the arb work but otherwise it's shut," said one broker.
Some brokers said industrial action by two main Venezuelan oil workers unions could give gasoline a boost if it lasted.
Unions Fedepetrol and Fetrahidrocarburos began an eight hour strike at 0500 GMT on Friday. Officials at state oil company PDVSA said participation in the strike was limited.
